title: Firmament Greek — observed repertoire
note: Observed characters are the test floor, not the design target. The target repertoire is the complete Greek and Coptic letters (U+0370–03FF, Greek letters only) and all of Greek Extended (U+1F00–1FFF), plus combining breathings, accents, dialytika and ypogegrammeni for decomposed input. Coptic letters and mathematical Greek symbols are out of scope.
